open_points.subject: REGISTRY_BASE_URL loading and startup validation
open_points.text: A30 now says “REGISTRY_BASE_URL is read by the Registry gateway at each call, not at start-up: it is no required start-up variable,” while R0-10 says environment configuration “is validated when it starts,” State 1 calls RuntimeSettings “the startup configuration … read from the environment,” and A30 still says config.runtime_environment_variables is “read into RuntimeSettings.”
open_points.question: Is REGISTRY_BASE_URL excluded from startup loading and validation and read directly from the environment for every Registry call, or is its value captured and validated in RuntimeSettings at startup?
options: Exclude it from startup RuntimeSettings and read the current environment value on every Registry call.
Load and validate it at startup with the other environment variables.
Load an optional startup value into RuntimeSettings and have Registry calls use that captured value.
open_points.default_guess: Follow the changed, specific A30 rule: exclude REGISTRY_BASE_URL from startup loading and validation and read it on every Registry call.

witness.initial: All otherwise-required configuration is valid, but REGISTRY_BASE_URL is absent from the process environment.
events: The deployment operator starts the portal service.
outcomes: Under changed A30, startup succeeds; only a later Registry call fails with transport_error.
Under R0-10/startup-RuntimeSettings wording, startup validation refuses to start because an environment-configured Registry endpoint is missing.
witness.observer: The deployment operator and health-checking infrastructure
